body:
Phase 3 item 3.1 of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST). Builds on the merged Phase 1+2 plugin (plugins/adlc-pi: lib/{rails-checker,doctrine,extension,reactive-gate,build-gate,flail,evidence}.mjs; wiring tests drive handlers through a fake pi object — mirror that harness).

=== VERIFIED pi API FACTS (0.80.3; types in node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts, docs mirrored in the package's docs/ dir) ===
- Prompt templates: markdown files in a package's `prompts/` dir (or `pi.prompts` manifest entries) become `/name` commands; frontmatter `description` + optional `argument-hint`; `$ARGUMENTS`/args are appended per pi's template rules (read the package docs/prompt-templates.md for exact expansion semantics before writing them).
- `pi.registerCommand(name, { description, getArgumentCompletions?(argumentPrefix) -> AutocompleteItem[]|null, handler(args, ctx) })`; command ctx is ExtensionCommandContext (adds waitForIdle/newSession etc.).
- Dialogs: `ctx.ui.select(title, options: string[], opts) -> Promise<string|undefined>`, `ctx.ui.confirm(title, message) -> Promise<boolean>`, `ctx.ui.input(...)`. In non-TUI modes (rpc/json/print) dialogs resolve undefined — every command must degrade gracefully (notify + return, never hang or throw).
- @adlc/core exports scaffold helpers (ensureGitignore, ensureFormatterIgnores); @adlc/gate-manifest/lib/record.mjs record() writes chain-valid manifest entries (see lib/evidence.mjs precedent).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Prompt templates in plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/ registered via package.json `pi.prompts: ["./prompts"]`: adlc-spec.md (P0–P2 workflow), adlc-decompose.md (P2), adlc-verify-build.md (build-gate/preflight), adlc-prosecute.md (P5 evidence recording), adlc-distill.md (P7), adlc-maintain.md (decay checks). PORT the content from the sibling command suites — plugins/adlc-cursor/command/*.md and plugins/adlc-opencode/command/*.md are the source material; adapt tool spellings to pi (skills already exist in plugins/adlc-pi/skills — templates route to the same `adlc` CLIs; keep each template consistent with the corresponding skill, and cross-reference rather than duplicating doctrine).
2. registerCommand interactive trio in a new lib/commands.mjs (wired from lib/extension.mjs):
   - `/adlc-init`: verifies the adlc CLI is on PATH (pi.exec('adlc', ['--version'])), scaffolds .adlc/ (tickets.json from tickets.example.json shape if absent, ensureGitignore/ensureFormatterIgnores from @adlc/core), and reports what it did. Idempotent — running twice changes nothing the second time.
   - `/adlc-ticket [id]`: with an id argument, activates that ticket; without, ctx.ui.select over ticket ids+titles from the loaded tickets file. Activation writes .adlc/current-ticket.json DIRECTLY (this is the human acting through a command handler, not the agent through a tool — the trust-root freeze governs agent tools; note this in a comment) and records an 'adlc-ticket-switch' evidence entry via lib/evidence.mjs. getArgumentCompletions completes ticket ids. After activation the extension state must reflect the new ticket immediately (call the existing reload path, do not wait for turn_start).
   - `/adlc-approve-spec <spec-path>`: the G1 human gate as a real modal — ctx.ui.confirm showing the spec path; on approve, record a chain-valid 'spec-approval' entry via @adlc/gate-manifest record() naming the spec path and (if resolvable) its sha256; on decline, record nothing and notify. Missing/unreadable spec path → error notify, no dialog.
3. Non-TUI degradation: every dialog result is checked for undefined; commands notify a clear message and return (AC-tested).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: the six prompt templates exist under plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/ with frontmatter `description` (and argument-hint where args are expected); package.json pi.prompts includes "./prompts". VERIFY: node --test asserting file presence + frontmatter parse + manifest field.
- AC2: /adlc-ticket with a valid id writes current-ticket.json, records an evidence entry, and the very next tool_call gates against the NEW ticket (no turn boundary needed). VERIFY: wiring test through the fake pi harness.
- AC3: /adlc-ticket with no args surfaces ui.select with one option per ticket; choosing one activates it; select returning undefined (non-TUI) leaves state unchanged and notifies. VERIFY: wiring tests with a fake ui.select.
- AC4: /adlc-approve-spec on an existing file + confirm=true appends a chain-valid manifest entry (verify() passes) naming the spec; confirm=false appends nothing; nonexistent path notifies an error without opening a dialog. VERIFY: node --test.
- AC5: /adlc-init on a bare temp repo creates .adlc/tickets.json + gitignore entries and is idempotent (second run: no diff). When the adlc CLI is missing (pi.exec fails), it notifies the install command instead of scaffolding a broken workspace. VERIFY: node --test.
- AC6: full root `npm test` exits 0; `node scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs` passes.

Suppressions are denied; marker fixtures by concatenation (see test precedent). Do not modify sibling plugins or packages/**; if a core helper is missing, STOP and escalate.
title: pi Phase 3a: /adlc command surface — prompt templates for phase workflows + interactive registerCommand trio
